Difference between next forecasted ex-date and next forecasted declared date to find timing surprises (bdvd_next_est_ex_dt vs bnedd). SUGGESTION1: both fields used; both backfilled due coverage ~0.524. SUGGESTION4 limited userCounts. KEEP_IN_MIND followed. Confidence: 0.42

Measure shift in cross-sectional percentile of bp12m_yld over a window (ts_rank/backfill). SUGGESTION1: bp12m_yld used and backfilled. SUGGESTION4 high user/alpha. KEEP_IN_MIND compact. Confidence: 0.71

results.idea: Large index contributors with improving health
results.description: Identify names with high bp12m_dip and increasing dividend health. SUGGESTION1: anl48_bp12m_dip and anl48_bdvd_curr_dvd_health used; dip coverage high no backfill; health backfilled. SUGGESTION4 health user/alpha used. KEEP_IN_MIND observed. Confidence: 0.58

results.idea: Dividend forecast momentum vs last gross
results.description: ts_delta of bpda vs equity_ldg to detect accelerating forecasts relative to last gross. SUGGESTION1: two fields; both backfilled. SUGGESTION4 moderate counts. KEEP_IN_MIND respected. Confidence: 0.55

Combine vec_range and vec_stddev of bulk_dvd_hist to detect irregular payouts. SUGGESTION2: used vector operators on anl48_bulk_dvd_hist_ibs; SUGGESTION3: vector coverage ~0.5153 used as-is. KEEP_IN_MIND: two vector ops but one field. Confidence: 0.41

results.idea: Dividend projected vs index-type adjusted zscore
results.description: Normalize bp12m_yld within index type using group_zscore with anl48_indx_typ (group parameter). SUGGESTION1: two fields used; backfilled bp12m_yld. SUGGESTION4 leveraged high user/alpha. KEEP_IN_MIND group used properly. Confidence: 0.66

results.idea: Dividend forecast leading indicator from bulk serial
results.description: Use vec_avg of bulk_bdvd_all_projections_ibs as smoothed forecast signal and compare to stock bp12m_yld. SUGGESTION2: vec_avg used. SUGGESTION3: backfilled bp12m_yld; vector coverage ~0.5242 used. KEEP_IN_MIND respected. Confidence: 0.47

results.idea: Dividend pay-date volatility vs record-date volatility
results.description: Compare ts_std_dev of pay date (bdhpd) and record date (bdhrd) to detect operational instability. SUGGESTION1: two fields used and backfilled. SUGGESTION4 moderate user/alpha. KEEP_IN_MIND observed. Confidence: 0.43

results.idea: Immediate dividend catalyst: announced but not yet ex
results.description: Long names with positive recent bdhd announce (bdhad) but ex-date still in future (td_xe_dvd). SUGGESTION1: two fields used; both backfilled. SUGGESTION4 limited counts but logical. KEEP_IN_MIND short. Confidence: 0.5

results.idea: Dividend forecast surprise normalized by index member count
results.description: Normalize bpda surprise by count_index_members to reduce index composition bias. SUGGESTION1: anl48_bpda and anl48_count_index_members used; bpda backfilled, index count high coverage. SUGGESTION4 applied. KEEP_IN_MIND followed. Confidence: 0.56
